src2='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    divider_row = next((r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for c in range(w))), None)
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = bg
    if divider_col is not None:
        left, right = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        if right < divider_col:
            toward_divider = divider_col - 1 - right
            toward_outer = -left
            shift = toward_divider if toward_divider <= abs(toward_outer) else toward_outer
            marker = left + shift - 1 if shift > 0 else right + shift + 1 if shift < 0 else (left - 1 if right < divider_col else right + 1)
        else:
            toward_divider = divider_col + 1 - left
            toward_outer = (w - 1) - right
            shift = toward_divider if abs(toward_divider) <= toward_outer else toward_outer
            marker = right + shift + 1 if shift < 0 else left + shift - 1 if shift > 0 else (left - 1 if right < divider_col else right + 1)
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c + shift] = grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][marker] = 8

            toward_divider = divider_row - 1 - bottom

            shift = toward_divider if abs(toward_divider) <= toward_outer else toward_outer
            marker = bottom + shift + 1 if shift < 0 else top + shift - 1 if shift > 0 else (top - 1 if bottom < divider_row else bottom + 1)

src3='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    divider_row = next((r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for c in range(w))), None)

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = bg
    if divider_col is not None:
        left, right = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        if right < divider_col:
            shift = divider_col - 1 - right
            marker = (left + left + shift) // 2 if shift else left - 1
        else:
            shift = divider_col + 1 - left
            marker = (right + right + shift) // 2 if shift else right + 1
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c + shift] = grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][marker] = 8
    else:
        top, bottom = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        if bottom < divider_row:
            shift = divider_row - 1 - bottom
            marker = (top + top + shift) // 2 if shift else top - 1
        else:
            shift = divider_row + 1 - top
            marker = (bottom + bottom + shift) // 2 if shift else bottom + 1
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r + shift][c] = grid[r][c]
        for c in range(w):
            out[marker][c] = 8
    return out
'''
